subject: TransientLog onboarding: evidence & timeline request
messages:
From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@finovapay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@finovapay.com, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finovapay.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: TransientLog addition and evidence request

Hi Ben —

Quick heads-up: Finova is planning to add a short-list telemetry processor, TransientLog, to our telemetry stack for ingestion of anonymized event samplings. Before we progress the procurement paperwork, our security team needs the usual package:

- Confirmation they will be listed as a subprocessors in Redwood's DPA (name + roles).
- SOC 2 Type II or equivalent attestation.
- Data flow diagram showing where logs are buffered and any egress paths (especially cross-border).
- Encryption at rest and in transit details and KMS ownership.
- Retention & deletion policy for sampled telemetry (expected TTL).

We have a deadline to present the vendor package to our Risk Committee on Thurs 17 Dec. Can you confirm you can provide the subprocessor roster and evidence bundle by EOD Wed 16 Dec? I attached a short summary TransientLog sent (transientlog-dpa-summary.pdf) — they indicated partial SOC reports are available but some artifacts are redacted.

Thanks,
Ethan Morales
Senior Security Manager — Finova Payments

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@finovapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TransientLog addition and evidence request

Hi Ethan —

Thanks for the notice and for attaching the vendor summary. I’ll coordinate to get you a complete packet. Looping in Marissa (privacy intake lead), Kim (procurement & vendor security), and Laura (legal) to handle artifacts and timeline.

Initial ask from our side: can you confirm whether Finova requires a signed DPA addendum prior to Risk Committee review, or if an attestation + evidence bundle is sufficient for an interim approval? That will change the timeline a bit.

We’ll aim to deliver the subprocessor roster + whatever evidence TransientLog can provide by EOD Wed 16 Dec; if we hit redactions we’ll include a redaction log and attestations from TransientLog about where the material is held.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Platform Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@finovapay.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TransientLog addition and evidence request

Thanks for the ping — I pulled TransientLog’s public-facing materials and matched them against Finova’s checklist. I’ve attached a one-page intake checklist (evidence_checklist.xlsx) with the gaps I can see. Actions I recommend:

1) Ask TransientLog for an unredacted SOC 2 summary (redactions are common; we should request a view-only redaction log and the assertion letters).
2) Request a high-level data flow diagram that explicitly marks any third-country processors and egress routes.
3) Get their retention policy and a statement on sample aggregation methods (confirm no PII persists).
4) Confirm whether TransientLog uses a customer-managed KMS or vendor-managed keys and where keys are located.
5) For procurement: propose a provisional onboarding window (canary) limited to 1% traffic for 30 days while we validate telemetry quality.

I will reach out to our onboarding contact at TransientLog now and ask for the artifacts — copying Finova so your Risk team sees the timeline. If we can get SOC notes + flow diagram by Tue 15 Dec EOD, I think we can hit Wed 16 Dec for a consolidated packet.

Marissa Cole
Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@finovapay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TransientLog addition and evidence request

Ethan —

Quick operational note from procurement/security: TransientLog confirmed they can provide
- SOC 2 Type II (view-only with redaction log)
- Data flow diagram (PDF)
- KMS details: vendor-managed keys hosted in us-west-2 (no customer KMS)
- Retention: default 30 days for sampled telemetry, with a configurable TTL down to 7 days

We received their KV/egress map and I’m attaching it for visibility (kv-egress-map.pdf). We will push for explicit language in the DPA addendum that restricts cross-border egress and requires notification before any change.

Provisional timeline we can commit to: consolidated evidence packet to Finova by EOD Wed 16 Dec (today). If Finova needs a signed DPA addendum before Risk Committee review, we can prepare an addendum template but realistic execution will take additional 3–5 business days for countersign.

Kimberly Park
Senior Vendor Security — Redwood Inference

Attachment: kv-egress-map.pdf (diagram)

---

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finovapay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: TransientLog addition and evidence request

Thank you — we received the SOC pointers and the KV/egress map. That’s helpful. Two quick clarifications from Risk: 

1) When you say "redaction log" for SOC 2, can you confirm whether TransientLog will permit an independent reviewer (on Finova's behalf) to inspect unredacted material under an NDA? If not, we'll need the attestation plus a redaction summary.

2) For the provisional canary, please confirm the exact routing policy (percentage and customers affected) and whether Finova can opt-out for the canary period.

If you can send the consolidated packet (and a short note about whether a signed addendum is necessary before committee review), we’ll circulate to the Risk Committee this afternoon. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia Chen
Data Privacy Lead — Finova Payments
